title: Beach Music Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: When a cozy space is all you need, the ‘Luck of the Draw’ cottage provides the ideal setting for a vacation to quaint Seaside.
description_expanded: Description14 PENSACOLA STREET1 QUEENBeach Music | One-Bedroom Guest Cottage Steps from the SandWelcome to Beach Music, a charming one-bedroom guest cottage perfectly positioned in the heart of Seaside, Florida, just 69 feet from the beach access at Pensacola. Located directly on Scenic Highway 30A, this inviting retreat offers the rare combination of beachside proximity and walkable access to Seaside’s iconic town center—just a 3-minute stroll to more than 35 shops and restaurants.Unbeatable Location Near Beach & Town CenterFew Seaside vacation rentals can match this location. Beach Music sits just steps from the sugar-white sand and emerald waters of the Gulf while remaining moments from Seaside’s vibrant dining, shopping, and entertainment. Whether you’re heading out for a sunrise beach walk or an evening concert in the square, everything is right outside your door.Private Outdoor Spaces with Coastal CharmEnter the cottage via a quaint footpath and enjoy the front bistro seating area, perfect for morning coffee or evening drinks. A private charcoal grill invites relaxed dinners at home. Out back, double doors open to a private deck with Adirondack seating, where ocean breezes and the sound of crashing waves create the ultimate coastal backdrop for sunset cocktails.Bright, Open Living with Beach Cottage StyleInside, the cheerful pink exterior gives way to warm, inviting interiors filled with natural light. The open-concept living space features a rustic wood ceiling, new flooring, and comfortable furnishings. A dining table seats four, and the efficiency kitchen is thoughtfully equipped with a four-burner cooktop, under-counter refrigerator, microwave, convection toaster oven, and coffee maker—ideal for easy meals during your Seaside getaway.Airy Bedroom Suite with Juliette BalconyA spiral staircase leads to the second-level queen bedroom suite, offering a peaceful retreat after a day at the beach. The bedroom includes a large armoire, dresser, flat-screen TV, and an ensuite bathroom with a shower. Charming wainscot paneling adds character, while French doors open to a Juliette balcony with seating for two—a perfect spot to enjoy sunrise views and the soothing sounds of the nearby surf.A Quintessential Seaside, Florida EscapeWith its white picket fence, cozy details, and unmatched proximity to both the beach and Seaside town center, Beach Music delivers a truly authentic Florida coastal experience. Ideal for couples seeking a romantic escape or a peaceful weekend retreat, this guest cottage invites you to relax, unwind, and enjoy the best of Seaside, Florida—just steps from the sand.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES 420 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spacePrivate residential Seaside beach access at Pensacola Pavilion, part of the largest private residential beach on Scenic Highway 30ALocated just 69 feet (approximately a 1-minute walk) to beach accessFor the safety and security of guests and the property, there are two exterior security cameras onsite: One camera faces the front door entry. One camera is positioned at the beginning of the footpath leading to the cottage. These cameras monitor exterior areas only.Charcoal grill for casual outdoor cookingOutdoor shower for rinsing off after beach daysWi-Fi provided throughout the cottagePeacock Alley linens, featuring fresh, luxurious sheets and plush towels throughout the homeEfficiency kitchen equipped with an under-counter refrigerator (no oven or dishwasher)Access to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes available for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedOne parking pass issued (golf carts are considered vehicles)Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners in Seaside; special circumstances or medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-001861
